Silhouette by The Zero Phuket

Condominium in Naiyang
HomeSaleSilhouette by The Zero Phuket

Developer renders and show-unit photos from the official The Zero Phuket project page. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

Silhouette by The Zero Phuket is a boutique, low-density condominium of 150 residences in Nai Yang, between Sirinat National Park and Nai Yang Beach. It is a condominium, not a villa project: the mix runs from studios to three-bedroom residences, with two-bedroom penthouse suites.

The developer, The Zero, is a UK company with an eco-smart building approach. A groundbreaking ceremony has been held and completion is quoted as the third quarter of 2028 (other listings say the second quarter).

Press coverage quotes prices from about 4.4 million baht. Ask us on WhatsApp for the current price list and which units remain.

Silhouette by The Zero Phuket: key facts

  • Silhouette by The Zero Phuket is a condominium in Naiyang, Phuket, developed by The Zero.
  • Units: 1–2 bedrooms, 37.5–55.2 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Jun 2028.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿4,712,625 (developer price).
  • Nearest beach: Nai Yang Beach (about 350 m).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Nai Yang Beach (about 350 m).
